messages.subject: Change range labels on sliders
parts: I have a slider that ranges continuously from -10 to 10, and the left hand of the slider indicates "-10" and the right side indicates "10".  Is there any way I can have the slider indicate "Negative" on the left and "Positive" on the right, or "Low" and "High"?
